title: Smoothed nearest-key target features on unique-rating-key rows -- fold-0 screen

mechanism_distinct_from_closed.why_different: Nearest-key smoothing transports label signal to rows whose exact key is rare/unseen by aggregating the smoothed target means of FIT keys at Hamming distance exactly 1 (65 candidate keys/row under base-6 arithmetic over the 13 integer ratings). Exact-key TE contributes only where a key repeats; nearest-key reaches the 36%-of-rows unique-rating-key weak region (atlas segment AUC 0.95032, largest contiguous residual).
mechanism_distinct_from_closed.prior: LOW (queue rank 3): members already see all 13 ratings and generalize across similar keys via splits -- this tests whether an explicit Hamming-neighbor target estimate adds anything beyond what tree splits extract.

scope.submission_budget_note: 0 of 2 final submissions used; none authorized by this prereg

anti_leakage.primary: No fold-0 label in any supervised fit (features, targets, early-stopping).
anti_leakage.feature_provenance: te_* family: the nearest-key table is target-dependent and MUST be recomputed per fold with inner cross-fitting. NearestKeyTE.crossfit(fit_key, y_fit, fit_R) encodes FIT rows with an inner 5-fold cross-fit (no row sees its own label); NearestKeyTE.apply(fit_key_FIT, y_FIT, apply_key_EVAL, apply_R_EVAL) encodes EVAL rows from the FIT table only (EVAL labels never read).
anti_leakage.segment_flags: unique/dup rating-key flags are transductive and LABEL-FREE (value_counts over combined tr+te ratings, identical to the phase-19 atlas is_dup definition). Permitted under the provenance table (cnt_* transductive class).
anti_leakage.reconstruction_rule: nk features for FIT rows come only from crossfit (inner folds within FIT); nk features for EVAL rows come only from the FIT table; no EVAL label anywhere.

features.definition: nk1 = (sum_k cnt_k*mean_k + lam*prior)/(sum_k cnt_k + lam) over Hamming-d-1 neighbor keys, gated to prior if aggregate count < min_count; nk1_logc = log1p(total neighbor count); nk1_nk = log1p(number of distinct neighbor keys found)
features.params_frozen: lam/min_count/inner_folds/inner_seed FROZEN here; no smoothing sweep after results
features.encoding: base-6 over the 13 integer ratings (positions 0..12), rating order = src/phase20/h19c_nearest_key.RATING_COLS (atlas order)

members.control: LightGBM, rich view 'full', WITHOUT the nk feature block
members.treatment: identical LightGBM, rich view 'full', WITH the nk feature block appended
members.only_difference: presence of the 3 nk columns (crossfit for FIT rows, apply for EVAL rows)
members.params_note: same MEMBER_PARAMS as H19-A (rich view + extra_trees verified +2.75e-4 on full view); consistent across control/treatment so the ONLY delta is the nk block
members.early_stopping: inner 10% split carved from FIT (folds 1-4) ONLY, patience 300; never the eval fold (fold 0)
members.features: ViewBuilder(tr, te, 'full').assemble(fi=FIT, y, val=EVAL, inner_seed=member_seed) -- fold-safe TE identical to H19-A; nk block appended after assembly

metrics.primary: fold-0 AUC (exact, sklearn roc_auc_score): control, treatment, delta = treat - ctrl

segments.definition: unique_rating_key = NOT is_dup (atlas transductive label-free flag); dup_rating_key = is_dup
segments.rationale: the mechanism targets the unique-key weak region; a gain concentrated there with no dup regression is the expected signature

metrics.correlations: Pearson of control/treatment vs champion route0 and aux0 halves (diversity signal)

portfolio.composition: equal-weight 11th aux member: aux11 = (10*aux0_logits + member_logits)/11; port = sigmoid((logit(route0) + aux11)/2)
portfolio.rule: equal weight, no tuning on fold 0; key delta = AUC(+treatment) - AUC(+control)

metrics.champion_reference: phase17_B1 per-fold route/portfolio npy, hash-asserted (CHAMPION_PORTFOLIO_SHA256 / CHAMPION_ROUTE_SHA256); fold-0 aux0_logits from classical(0, ...) (fold-0-safe: trains on folds 1-4); composition bit-exact vs stored portfolio

decision_rules.DEAD: d <= 0 (no standalone improvement), OR d < +3e-5 AND seg_u <= 0 (no indicative standalone gain and no unique-region edge)
decision_rules.PATH_TO_REPLICATION: d >= +3e-5 AND seg_u > 0 AND portfolio delta (AUC(+treat)-AUC(+ctrl)) >= 0
decision_rules.gates_not_validatable_by_fold0: the full promotion gate (>=1.5e-5 mean paired, >=2.5x paired SE, positive in >=4/5 folds) CANNOT be validated by fold 0 alone; a PATH verdict only recommends folds 1-4 for FUTURE consideration and does NOT launch them
decision_rules.negative_rule: if DEAD, record NEGATIVE for this exact mechanism (lam/min_count/encoding) and do not rerun identically; any future retry must change a predeclared mechanism (different neighborhood radius, different key definition, or a different estimator), not retune lam/min_count post hoc.

forbidden: rerunning the identical recipe after a DEAD verdict
